title: Feelings
descriptionFa: دوست داشتن و متنفر بودن، حال و احساس‌ها، و ترجیح دادن، امید داشتن و خواستن.

words.example: I love my grandmother's cooking.
I like my new school.
I don't like cold weather.
I hate waiting in traffic.
I really like this song.
words.tipFa: I really like it یا I like it very much. ولی I very like it غلطه.

words.example: She was very happy about her exam results.
words.tipFa: برای خبر: happy about the news. برای آدم: I'm happy for you.

words.example: The end of the film was very sad.
Dad was angry because I came home late.
words.tipFa: از دست کسی: angry with someone.

words.example: She was upset when her friend forgot her birthday.
Can you close the window? I'm cold.
words.tipFa: «سردمه» می‌شه I'm cold. ولی I have a cold یعنی «سرما خوردم».

words.example: I'm hot. Can I open the window?
After the football match, I was very thirsty.
I didn't have breakfast, so I'm really hungry.
words.tipFa: «گرسنمه» می‌شه I'm hungry، نه I have hunger.

words.example: I'm tired after a long day at work.
We were surprised to see snow in April.
I'm a bit tired today.
words.tipFa: a little هم همین معنی رو داره: I'm a little tired.

words.example: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.tipFa: prefer A to B، نه than B.

words.example: I hope to see you again soon.
words.tipFa: دو شکل: I hope to pass و I hope (that) you pass.

words.example: My parents want me to study medicine.
words.tipFa: want someone to do something. ولی want that someone… غلطه.

words.example: I'm fine, thanks. How about you?
words.tipFa: برای پیشنهاد هم هست: How about a walk? (بریم قدم بزنیم؟)
